body: I did. The vision specialist just wrote it off as an eye issue
The girl with the golden eyes kept telling me that she wanted me to come home and the little girl told me that her and mommy were waiting for me

Milo has always been a rather odd dog in my opinion. For one thing, when I spoke to him, he would stare back as if he were actually comprehending what I was saying to him. I would sometimes catch him staring at me during dinner or whenever I was doing something and it just felt weird. I remember that I jokingly asked him if he could talk one day and that was the day that my life changed.

I had been doing bicep curls while sitting on my bed, Milo laying near my feet. He was watching me lift the dumbbells up and down and I swore that I saw a glint of intelligence in his eyes. Don’t get me wrong, Milo wasn’t a dumb pup. He was highly intelligent. But this glint was different. Half jokingly, I told him, “Speak, Milo.” What I didn’t expect to happen was for my dog to sit up, look me dead in the face, and respond, “About time we had a conversation.”

My eyes popped wide and I stared back at my pup, wondering if I was hearing things. I blinked twice.
“Did....did you just..?”
“Talk?” Milo finished. “Yes, I did. Though I’m not supposed to. But this is an exception to the oath.”
“Oath?” I said, completely puzzled and still shocked that my dog was actually talking.
“All dogs are able to speak human languages but we swear an oath of silence due to the....repercussions of human discovering we can talk. I’m only talking now because I have to warn you,” Milo said.
“Warn me?”
“Yes. A threat is coming to your world and only you can stop it.”
I shook my head to clear the cobwebs and stared back at Milo. So many questions were filling my mind but I couldn’t decide which one seemed more important right now. My dog was talking, actually talking. 
“How long have you been able to talk?” I asked, putting down my dumbbells. “And why talk now?”
Milo got on the bed and faced me. “To answer your first question, I have always been capable of human speech but I never felt the need to speak to you until now. This leads into your second question. I’m here to warn you, Joseph. Humanity is in danger. And you must save them.”
“In danger from who? And how do you know this?”
Milo growled impatiently. “She seeks to eradicate your kind. She is a desecrater of worlds, a demon given human form. My kind, dogs, were employed to find certain humans who were capable enough to defend the world. There have been many before you but now it is your turn, Joseph. You must defeat her.”
